question: Who is regarded as the highest-qualified teacher according to the Malini teaching?
premises: The Malini teaching describes a person of innate awareness.
Such a person is the highest-qualified candidate.
Because he possesses knowledge, he is regarded as a teacher.
inference: A person with innate awareness and knowledge is the highest-qualified teacher in the Malini tradition.
uncertainties: The verse compresses the Malini citation, so the exact quoted wording is not given.
plain_english: Thus, according to the teaching of the revered Malini, one who has innate awareness is the highest-qualified person; because he possesses knowledge, he is regarded as a teacher.
